description: This file defines classes and structures related to cgroup memory and processor information within the WPEFramework's ProcessContainers namespace. It includes classes for managing memory info, processor info, and gathering cgroup metrics such as memory usage and CPU usage per core.

classes.name: CGroupMemoryInfo
classes.description: Represents memory information for a cgroup, including allocated, resident, and shared memory.

classes.name: CGroupProcessorInfo
classes.description: Represents CPU usage information for a cgroup, including per-core usage and total usage.

classes.name: CGroupMetrics
classes.description: Helper class to collect and provide cgroup metrics such as memory and CPU usage.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage information for the cgroup.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Retrieves CPU core usage information for the cgroup.
